summary.text: Rob Tupper is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 4-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer and Democratic precinct committee officer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he decided to run after seeing that the incumbent was unopposed on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Rob Tupper earned a high school diploma from Paso Robles High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Alaska, Fairbanks in 1990, and a graduate degree from Whitworth University in 2010.
His career experience includes working as an engineer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Tupper said he has been a Precinct Committee Officer for a couple of years.
He said he would argue that a Democrat could negotiate more effectively on Eastern Washington's issues from the majority party.
Among his stated key messages were opposition to data centers, citing energy use and water quality, and concern about the cost of pre-K through college education.
